fields.title: 📖 Muḥākamah: The judgment of the Prophet ﷺ is binding
fields.body:
🖋️ **ash-Shāfiʿī** said:

> ***“ash-Shāfiʿī explained that Allah has made following His Messenger ﷺ obligatory.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever rejects the judgment of the Messenger ﷺ does not reject a mere opinion. He contradicts the command of Allah.

immutable.source: 📝 ash-Shāfiʿī, ar-Risālah, Kapitel über die Pflicht, der Sunnah des Gesandten ﷺ zu folgen.
